articles.summary: AI Is Changing the Shape of the NetworkThink of how a city handles growing traffic. First, it widens the roads. Then it adds dedicated bus lanes. Eventually it builds a subway under the streets. Each stage solves the same problem, moving more people, but the infrastructure looks different every time, and the earlier stages don't disappear once the next one shows up.
